emulation.eligibility_mapping: units.tsv eligible；仅使用处理前记录
emulation.assignment_mapping: units.tsv strategy_id 是观察分类，不是随机分配
emulation.time_zero_mapping: units.tsv time_zero；0时观测先于首次处理
emulation.strategy_mapping: 需核对实际灌溉记录；本合成示例仅演示表结构
emulation.followup_mapping: 第0天至90天；提前失访需记录原因
emulation.estimand_mapping: 拟估计持续策略效果；仅有基线分类不足以支持依从性分析
emulation.analysis_mapping: Deterministic software verification; no scientific claim
limitations: Synthetic data only; known numerical coefficient is not an observed biological effect

identification.exchangeability: 需评估基线与随时间变化的共同原因是否被测量
identification.positivity: 在混杂变量各层检查两策略支持与权重分布
identification.consistency: 明确剂量、持续时间与允许的策略版本
identification.interference: 评估地块间水分流动；必要时定义缓冲区与暴露映射

missing_data_plan: 区分未测量、失访、检测限；不默认填0

provenance.transformations: 24 balanced rows: response=4+2*T+0.5*x+/-0.25; paired residuals cancel within each treatment and x stratum
